problems.problem: Contact detail crop [46,1055,687,1305] confirms a real contact shadow: a small soft dark smudge sits exactly under the lower-left star point at (160,1195), so the shadow is NOT absent and offset_y 0 is correct. However the footprint is only ~49px wide under that single tip while the 483px-wide star's lower-right point terminates near y≈1120 with no shadow or contact at all. The flacon therefore reads as balanced impossibly on one needle point; references 2 and 4 ground their bottles with a footprint shadow proportional to the visible base. Shadow opacity 0.35 / blur 10 / width_scale default is too faint and too narrow to sink the mass into the frosted grain as the concept demands.

product_height_ratio is exactly 0.50 (bbox 475-1195), the floor of the hero range; against references 2-4 where the product dominates 60-75% of frame, the star reads small and isolated in a large empty frosted field, with dead space above the cap (y<475) and below the base (y>1195).

The regenerated frosted sheet shows hard vertical panel seams at x≈80 and x≈1000 plus a sharp wall-to-floor horizon at y≈975 that cuts directly behind the star's lower points. These read as constructed set flats rather than the declared seamless sweeping sheet, and the horizon line competes with the bottle silhouette instead of staying a quiet tonal transition.

The right-hand text column is top-weighted and thin: logo at y518, title block 605-716, then only a 151px frost-blue rule at y763, leaving roughly 500px of empty frosted column beneath. Beside a 720px-tall product the column lacks vertical balance and the etched-label rhythm promised by the concept; hierarchy is correct but unresolved compared with reference 2's confident label block.

changes.value: One continuous seamless frosted acrylic surface curving gently from vertical wall into horizontal ground with no visible seam, edge or horizon line, pale ice grey frost grain, a single soft cool white glow blooming behind upper centre, soft high-key diffuse dawn illumination fading evenly toward the lower frame, empty scene, no objects
